text: Wata on waɗu ngoondooje mon ɗen hujja heedorɗo golle ɗiggere e kulol Alla e moƴƴingol hakkunde yimɓe ɓen. Ko woni tun, si on woondii fii woppugol teertoo ɗiggere, on waɗay tan kaffaara woondoore nden, jokkiton ɗiggere. Allah ko Nanoowo haalaaji mo'on, Annduɗo golleeji mo'on; O Yoɓitoyay on ɗum.
